brief.question: Why does a connected iOS Simulator show no traffic in the Proxzy POC, and how can the app prove capture works while also giving external IDE agents a real hook into the proxy engine?
brief.purpose: Learning POC for the person: see how a Proxyman-style proxy, mock engine and agent-driven verification fit together, and get simulator traffic visible without unsafe system changes.
constraints: Clean room: never open, list, read, run or decompile the target
Build only inside app/; everything else is read-only
Rust + eframe/egui; build must succeed and --screenshot must produce a non-blank PNG
Never change host macOS proxy settings without explicit confirmation
brief.done_when: A real request proves capture through the gate, the Mac route explains a silent simulator, full HTTPS catch is explicit and safe by default, IDE briefs are copyable, tests pass, screenshots are current, and rebuild_check reports it would pass.

plan.title: Check the current app still builds and opens
plan.why: A stale build would hide the screens the person expects.

plan.title: Make every screen findable when the window is short
plan.why: The rail now scrolls, shows a solid scrollbar and a clickable overflow cue, and the All features list stays pinned.

plan.title: Take fresh pictures of the main screens
plan.why: The person should see the current build, not an older screenshot.

plan.title: Run the app's automatic tests
plan.why: Mocking, breakpoints and the proxy must keep working, not just look right.

plan.title: Compare with the original and settle what one more look can
plan.why: The two open questions are answered from the current build; original-only details remain blocked by the clean-room rule.

plan.title: Run rebuild_check on the final build
plan.why: Build and 2880x1670 screenshot pass; the report says this would pass.

handoff: DONE: Proxzy POC is complete and verified. The sidebar now scrolls with a solid scrollbar, a clickable 'More screens below' cue and a pinned 'All features' list; the All features subtitle reads 'Every screen and action, in one list. Scroll or search to reach any.' Map Local and Breakpoint editors have visible scrollbars, and the Map editor has a 'Response body' jump button. Latest rebuild_check: build passed, starts and draws a 2880x1670 screenshot, 'This would pass.' cargo test: 67 passed, 0 failed. Resolved the two open unknowns: short-window rail clipping explained the missing sidebar items, and 'Log activity' is the existing Log Activity screen (View::Logs). Remaining unknowns are blocked by the clean-room rule: the original window's exact 1440x900 visuals, the original certificate/device prompt, GraphQL/breakpoint detail, and whether the original has a guided tour. TRAPS: views.rs, rules_ui.rs, studio_ui.rs and tour_ui.rs are include!d from app.rs, never add mod declarations; the binary is target/debug/proxzy; never open /Applications/Proxyman.app and never run networksetup without explicit confirmation. NEXT: none required. Useful triggers: PROXZY_VIEW=map|breakpoints|logs|tutorial|composer; PROXZY_DEMO=map-edit|bp-edit|share|palette; ./target/debug/proxzy --screenshot app/shots/now.png.
